name: Proofpoint - User has clicked multiple links
xql_query:
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter _log_type in ("click-permitted", "click-blocked")
| comp count() as click_count,
        values(url) as urls_clicked
        by recipient
| filter click_count >= 2
description: The same user clicked 2+ malicious/monitored links (permitted or blocked) within the window - repeated risky click behavior.
alert_name: Proofpoint - User has clicked bad links multiple times in a week
alert_description:
What fired: one user clicked >=2 links flagged by Proofpoint URL Defense in the window.

Why it matters: repeated clicking on flagged links indicates a highly susceptible or actively-targeted user; if any click was PERMITTED they reached a malicious site.

Investigate:
  - Review the mapped recipient and the list of clicked URLs on this alert.
  - Determine which clicks were permitted vs blocked; check web proxy/EDR for successful connections.
  - Review the user's authentication for compromise.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1566.002 - Spearphishing Link (TA0001 - Initial Access).
